scope: Additive standalone test-only Darwin process identity probe; source review only
rootApproval: New files only under platform/runtime/testdata/darwin_identity_probe; no existing runtime, CLI or shared fixture edits and no builds or native jobs before coordination

findings: Invented wrong-version identifier could address a replacement process if the sole Wait reaped the original child before signalling.
Successful-start reader close and fresh protected-image close failures were discarded, bypassing cleanup reporting.
reviewHistory.limits: No native PID reuse was observed; these were source safety findings, not execution failures.

reviewHistory.result: Both prior findings closed. Sole Wait starts only in join after signal decisions; direct child remains unreaped during wrong-version control. Reader, fresh-image and failed-admission watch close failures prevent false cleanup success. Exact WaitStatus and registered exit event share one deadline. No further actionable safety finding within probe-only scope.

gofmt.scope: Go parsing and formatting only; no typecheck or C compilation

Private Apple identity layout and system symbol locations remain SDK/OS candidates pending native verification.
Only probe-created disposable children are controlled; no arbitrary PID or token control input.
Metadata-derived PID/version identifier is not authenticated credentials; kernel checks the actual caller's permission.
No raw PID signal fallback, task/debugger entitlement workaround, emulated native evidence or product control hook.
